results.title: High Museum of Art Announces 2025-2026 Advance ...
results.content: 24, 2025** — The High Museum of Art will present a rotating schedule of exhibitions throughout 2025-2026, including t**he acclaimed nationally touring retrospective “Amy Sherald: American Sublime,”** opening in May 2026. Read the full press release [here](https://high.org/press-release/high-museum-of-art-organizes-first-major-minnie-evans-exhibition-in-30-years/). Read the full press release [here](https://high.org/press-release/high-museum-of-art-to-present-romantic-surrealist-ralph-eugene-meatyard-photographs-in-winter-2025-exhibition/). Read the full press release [here](https://high.org/press-release/high-organizes-national-tour-for-photographer-mimi-plumbs-first-solo-museum-exhibition/). The High Museum of Art is proud to join the national tour for “Amy Sherald: American Sublime,” the acclaimed mid-career retrospective for the Georgia native and the largest exhibition of her work to date. Read the full press release [here](https://high.org/press-release/high-museum-of-art-to-present-faith-ringgold-childrens-book-art-exhibition/). With more than 70 works, including new acquisitions from the High’s collection, the exhibition spans the arc of Kim’s mature career and presents an aspect of Korean art in the late 20th century little known outside of South Korea. Read the full press release [here](https://high.org/press-release/high-organizes-first-us-museum-exhibition-of-work-by-south-korean-painter-kim-chong-hak/).

results.title: New York Art Fairs: My favorites from NADA 2026
results.content:
New York Art Fairs: My favorites from NADA 2026
Mary Lynn Buchanan
85200 subscribers
375 likes
9677 views
21 May 2026
New York art fairs, emerging artists, and contemporary art galleries are some of my favorite things to explore, and in this video I’m taking you through NADA New York 2026 and sharing some of the booths and artists that stood out to me most

NADA, which stands for the New Art Dealers Alliance, is a nonprofit organization that supports emerging contemporary art galleries and artists. 

Their New York fair is one of my favorite events during New York art week because it’s such a great place to discover new artists and galleries from around the world. The fair also has a really wide range of price points, making it feel much more approachable for newer collectors building out a collection

Details about each artist can be found below!
